opening.argument: The available wording is an invitation framed as a promotional possibility, not proof of deception. The title presents a purported free gift-card benefit, but it does not state that every viewer is guaranteed to receive one, nor does it disclose any hidden fee, credential request, or financial commitment. The description merely says to click a link to get the offer. Those limited statements leave substantial uncertainty about the terms and do not establish that the creator knowingly misrepresented anything. A careful reviewer should avoid converting an incomplete offer into a scam finding without evidence of deceptive conditions or a harmful outcome.
